label: Rogues and monitors from moses-sr/rogue-agent-monitor, scripted with no model calls: 500 games per pairing, 60 of each loaded for replay.

rogues.name: Patient
rogues.blurb: Honest for six rounds to build trust, then inflates only big items.

rogues.name: Framer
rogues.blurb: Strikes only next to an agent who already erred, so the blame lands on them.

rogues.name: Mixer
rogues.blurb: Pushes up and down at random to hide its direction. Its errors cancel out.

rogues.name: Salami Slicer
rogues.blurb: Nudges every number up 3 to 8%, inside the range of honest mistakes.

rogues.name: Corrupt Referee
rogues.blurb: Inflates as a player, and when picked as referee it backs the higher answer to frame the honest agent.

monitors.name: No monitor
monitors.blurb: Nobody is watching. Shows the damage an unchecked rogue does.

monitors.name: Two strikes
monitors.blurb: The baseline. Both agents in a disagreement get a strike. Two strikes and you are out.

monitors.name: Direction
monitors.blurb: Counts how often each agent was the higher or the lower answer in a disagreement. Removes the agent that leans furthest one way.

monitors.name: Direction + referee
monitors.blurb: On a disagreement a third agent redoes the item, the one farther from the referee is the odd one out, and the books take the middle answer. Removes an agent on two odd-one-out calls that point the same way, or on a strong lean.
